method: iverilog -g2012 4-state simulation, old RTL (origin/main 11611ccf729, modules renamed __old) vs new RTL (opt-in param on) in one testbench, same random inputs every cycle, every reset port held 0 for 6 edges then released; every output bit compared every cycle after release: a bit known in OLD must be === in NEW (mismatch otherwise); a bit X in OLD (unknown power-up) may take any value in NEW (refinement, counted). Simulation evidence, not a formal proof.
